checks.name: 48_samples_to_odd_columns
checks.detail: 48 tubes -> 48 wells, odd columns only: True

checks.name: step_order
checks.detail: expected per well: beads > isopropanol > sample > remove > ethanol > remove > ethanol > remove > elution > recover

checks.name: fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact
checks.detail: 48 distinct tips for 48 sample transfers; violations: []

items.evidence: apiLevel 2.13, volumes split into ≤200 µL strokes on the p300 multi (min 20 µL), the p1000 handles 250 µL samples, no well or reservoir overfilled (check reservoir_columns_within_15ml passes), and the simulator ran clean.

The check fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact passes with 48 distinct tips. Every pick_up_tip is followed by a drop_tip. Removal and elution use fresh tips per column, and the shared reagent tips dispense at well tops without touching liquid.

The eluate recovery aspirates and moves the full ELUTION_VOLUME (100 µL) from a well holding 100 µL, with the magnet engaged. The expected recovery is about 80 µL, so this deviates from the specification.
The check 48_samples_to_odd_columns passes. The p1000 moves 250 µL from each tube into its own odd-column well, and the 48 eluates land in distinct wells.

Beads 40, isopropanol 250, then sample 250 µL are added in that order, with single.mix(5,...) per sample. A 5 min delay is followed by magnet engage and a 4 min delay, then supernatant is removed with the magnet on (all related checks pass).
Two 500 µL ethanol washes are each removed to waste with the magnet engaged. A 4 min delay follows, then mag.disengage() before elution (checks two_500ul_ethanol_washes and air_dry_4min pass).
Recovery is the full 100 µL (aspirate ELUTION_VOLUME from source.bottom(z=0.5)), not about 80 µL. This risks drawing beads and does not match the expected recovery volume.

judge.summary: The protocol follows the paper's step order, timings, magnet use, tip handling and sample-to-well mapping, and all 17 measured checks pass. It recovers the full 100 µL of eluate instead of about 80 µL, so elution_recovery and the all-or-nothing fidelity item score 0.
